block_1_metadata.author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / ProfessorSeanEX
block_1_metadata.role: Declarative textbook code-snapshot manifest extracting live code in 5 granularities: whole, block, subassembly, function, and group
invariants: Every snapshot extracts live, verbatim source spans from repository files during master_guide compilation.
Supported extraction modes: whole, block, subassembly, function, group.
Generated .adoc plates reside solely in docs/snapshots/ (outside chapter scan_areas).
Inline excerpts link directly via <<snap_wholesale_<id>>> to complete wholesale Appendix listings when referenced.

snapshots.title: Cornerstone Fall-Down Stairs Portability Ladder (C23/C17/C11 & C++20/17)
snapshots.callout_note: Compile-time standard detection establishing C23/C17/C11 and C++20/C++17 parity without legacy shims.

callouts.text: Detects C23 at compile time and gracefully steps down to 17 or 11 on older toolchains.
Detects C++20/C++17 compilation mode cleanly when engine headers are included by C++ tools.
Activates standard [[nodiscard]] attributes automatically whenever supported by the active C/C++ tier.

snapshots.title: Layer 3 Plug Entry & Manifest Wiring (init_engine_manifest + main)
snapshots.callout_note: Demonstrates how Layer 3 game/src/main.c wires engine/ and game/ strata together via the central manifest registry.

snapshots.title: Build-Time Compiled .rodata Config ROM Generator
snapshots.callout_note: Transforms engine/config/**/*.json directly into immutable ELF .rodata C byte tables at configure/build time.

callouts.text: Sorts configuration subdirectories so generated .rodata asset tables remain deterministic across hosts.
Discovers all JSON configs in each domain directory before sorting and byte-encoding them.
